name: Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd (SYMBIOTEC)
tagline: Recently-IPO'd (Sept 2026) pharma API manufacturer with decelerating ROCE (14.0% -> 11.6%) despite steady revenue growth - fundamentals corroborate the bearish external view it was seeded with.
business_overview: Symbiotec Pharmalab manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), listed on NSE/BSE on 1 September 2026. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@JakeraChoudhury, Sept 2026) as a bearish, medium-conviction view.
fundamentals_table: FY24 Rs 716 Cr -> FY25 Rs 752 Cr -> FY26 Rs 869 Cr (+15.4% YoY FY26)
fundamentals_narrative: Symbiotec's revenue growth looks fine on the surface (+15.4% YoY in FY26, EBITDA +12.5%), but ROCE has been steadily declining over three years (14.03% -> 11.56%) even as debt was reduced - meaning returns on the capital employed are getting worse, not better, despite top-line growth. That is a capital-efficiency red flag on its own terms (not an AVOID-tier one), and it lines up with the bearish external view this name was seeded with. As a September-2026 IPO, there is minimal post-listing track record to weigh against this.
